description: Test suite for generating support packets and diagnostics in the Mattermost server, including support for log collection, configuration sanitization, and SAML provider detection.

methods.name: TestGenerateSupportPacket
methods.description: Tests support packet generation with and without logs, including error handling when log files are missing, and advanced logging configurations.

methods.name: TestGetSupportPacketDiagnostics
methods.description: Tests retrieval of support packet diagnostics, including license info, server info, LDAP, SAML, and Elasticsearch configurations, with various scenarios.

methods.name: TestGetSanitizedConfigFile
methods.description: Tests retrieval and sanitization of the configuration file, ensuring sensitive data is redacted and feature flags are included.

methods.name: TestGetCPUProfile
methods.description: Tests retrieval of CPU profiling data.

methods.name: TestGetHeapProfile
methods.description: Tests retrieval of heap profiling data.

methods.name: TestGetGoroutineProfile
methods.description: Tests retrieval of goroutine profiling data.

methods.name: TestDetectSAMLProviderType
methods.description: Tests detection of SAML provider type based on IdP descriptor URL, covering various known providers and edge cases.
